name: Dream of Origin
detailed_description:
Game Overview
Have you ever doubted that this world is not real? Do you truly want to live?
In Primordial Dream, you are pulled away from the real world into a system designed by higher-dimensional beings — the Primordial Space. This is the underlying framework of reality, a debug interface for civilization’s operation. Every mass extinction in history was a system reset initiated by the Overseer cleansing failed data.
Now humanity stands on the brink of deletion. You are the chosen variable.

Gameplay Features

🌀 Dream Trial System (Rogue-lite + Multiple Endings)
Each trial is generated by the Overseer, featuring combat, survival, psychological challenges, and narrative choices.
Failure costs part of your memory but retains an “evolution score” to strengthen future trials.

⚔️ Consciousness-Driven Combat System
Fight with melee weapons, simplified firearms, and “Dream Rune” combinations.
Blend action and strategy to develop a unique combat style.

📜 Non-linear Story & Consciousness Evolution
Your choices affect your “consciousness lineage” and final endings.
Will you maintain self-awareness within the dream, or become nameless code in the system?

🎭 Symbolic Worldbuilding & Puzzle Exploration
Each trial challenges a human flaw (fear, prejudice, attachment).
Through NPC fragments, memory shards, and dreamscapes, piece together why humanity is on trial.

🎧 Immersive Audio-Visual Experience
Realistic fantasy art style blending Eastern motifs and cyber symbols.
Original soundtrack combining ethnic instruments and synthesizers to evoke a philosophical dreamlike atmosphere.

Worldview Highlights

  • Earth civilization is a system node designed by higher-dimensional “programmers.”

  • The Primordial Space is a debug interface; trials test humanity’s right to exist.

  • All previous civilization collapses (dinosaurs, Atlantis) were system rollbacks.

  • The Overseer judges whether the variable qualifies.

  • If you refuse to respond to the Overseer, it will silence you.

Game Information
⏱ Main storyline length: 8–12 hours (multiple endings, replayability)
🎯 Tags: Third-person / Single-player / Multiple endings / Philosophical narrative / Fantasy action / Puzzle-solving
📶 Upcoming updates: Dream Editor (DLC), Rune Programming Module

When you refuse to answer the Overseer, the Overseer also abandons you.
— Will you write a satisfactory answer for all humanity?

short_description: Trapped in the monotony of modern life, you are offered a question: Do you truly wish to live? Thrust into a dimension beyond time, face trials woven from fear, memory, and unknown forces. Every choice might be your last. Will you discover the meaning of existence before it fades?
